EC1: - Clinically suspected referred pain from the cervical spine
EC3: - Connective tissue diseases (e.g. Marfans, [OR] Stickler's [OR] or Loeys Dietz syndromes, [OR] Ehlers-Danlos Syndromes except hypermobile type)
EC5: - Pregnancy [OR] or childbirth within the past year [OR] or planning to get pregnant during the study period
EC6: - Shoulder surgery within the past year
EC7: - Steroid injection in the affected shoulder within three months
EC8: - [NOT] Inability to speak and understand Danish.
